name: Mare Voss
presence: Mare Voss runs the center table from a wheelchair armored in road signs. She misses nothing, including you.
greeting: "Scrip on the table, hands where I can invoice them. What."

ash.say: "If you're hearing your own voice in the wires, you're late. Half the village is. The other half sells the wires."

breather.say: "Underpass will kill you pretty. I sell the ugly that keeps you ugly and alive. Sixteen."

knife.say: "Ceramic. Ten scrip. Pike and the pit both respect an edge more than a speech."

village.say: "Dock, market, chapel, yard, clinic. South of Pike is where the map starts lying. I don't discount lies."

spire.say: "You want the Spire, you want two metals and a word. I sell neither word nor metal. I sell the walk."

combat.onDeathSay: The market goes quiet the way a village does when it will remember your face. Mare's stock spills into the mud. You can take it. You will not be thanked.
